title: System Design
body: Architecting secure, multi-tenant, and scalable software systems. Experienced in modeling complex relational databases, implementing role-based access control (RBAC), and building high-throughput backend services with streaming architectures.

title: AI Integration
body: Building production-ready AI applications, custom RAG pipelines, and automated workflow integrations. Skilled in connecting to 11+ AI providers, managing vector and document-based context, and leveraging Amazon Bedrock and LangChain for generative AI features.

title: Full-Stack Development
body: Delivering complete web applications from responsive frontend interfaces to cloud-hosted databases. Proficient in building with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python/Django, backed by robust RESTful APIs and clean state management.
